name: NGT — New Lead Nurture Sequence
description: 5 emails over 14 days for new parent enquiries. Triggered when contact is added to 'New Lead' list.

emails.subject: Welcome to NextGen Tutors — here's what happens next
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for reaching out to NextGen Tutors. We're South Africa's most trusted affordable tutoring network, and we're here to help your learner succeed.

Here's what to expect over the next 24 hours:

  1. A member of our team will review your request
  2. We'll match you with 2–3 vetted tutors who specialise in your learner's subject and grade
  3. You'll receive tutor profiles to review before making any commitment

In the meantime, why not browse our full subject catalogue?

Warm regards,
The NextGen Tutors Team

emails.subject: How we match you with the perfect tutor
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Every learner is different — so is every tutor. Here's how our matching process works:

  • Subject expertise: We only match tutors who have demonstrable results in your learner's specific subject and grade level.
  • Location & format: Whether you prefer online or in-person, we match accordingly.
  • Personality fit: We consider learning style, personality, and goals.

Our tutors are vetted, reference-checked, and approved by our academic team before joining the platform.

Browse available tutors →

emails.subject: How we vet every NextGen Tutor
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Trust matters — especially when it comes to your child's education. Here's our vetting process:

  1. Online application with qualifications and subject proof
  2. Criminal background check and ID verification
  3. Subject knowledge assessment
  4. Reference check from previous students or institutions
  5. Trial lesson review by our academic team

Only tutors who pass all 5 stages are approved to teach on the NextGen platform.

Questions? Reply to this email anytime — a real person reads every message.

emails.subject: How Thabo went from a 42% to a 71% in 8 weeks
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thabo was a Grade 11 learner in Soweto struggling with Pure Mathematics. After just 8 weeks of weekly sessions with his NextGen tutor, he improved from 42% to 71% — and gained the confidence to tackle Paper 2 without anxiety.

His mother said: "I wish we had found NextGen Tutors in Grade 9. The difference is night and day."

We'd love to write a similar story for your learner.

Find your tutor today →

emails.subject: Last chance — spots filling fast this term
emails.body:

If you'd like to lock in a spot for {{contact.first_name}}, now is a great time.
